import { WorkError, taskInput, businessObjectReference } from "./index.js";
import { readTaskRunSubmissionDisposition } from "./task-run-submission.js";
export const sourceFollowupNotice = '此前提交结果未知，可能已执行并产生费用。本轮只按本人新的核验要求工作，不推定此前动作未发生，也不自动重做。原目标中的工具、资料和审批限制继续适用。';
export const resultFollowupNotice = '本轮是本人新确认的成果重核验。原执行与来源记录保留，不自动重复此前动作。原目标中的工具、资料和审批限制继续适用。';
export const errorRecoveryNotice = '原执行已失败。本轮是本人明确确认的新请求，按原固定来源继续工作；原失败、输入、费用和动作回执保留，不推定此前没有副作用，不自动重做旧动作。原目标中的工具、资料和审批限制继续适用。';
const uuid = (v) => typeof v === 'string' && /^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[1-8][a-f0-9]{3}-[89ab][a-f0-9]{3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$/i.test(v);
const sha = (v) => typeof v === 'string' && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(v);
const positive = (v) => Number.isSafeInteger(v) && Number(v) > 0;
const instruction = (v) => typeof v === 'string' && v === v.trim() && !!v && v.length <= 8000 && !/[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]/.test(v);
const denied = () => new WorkError('teloa/invalid-input', '请核对原执行、固定来源，并明确提交本轮核验要求。');
export function readTaskRunSourceFollowupCommand(value) {
    const row = taskInput(value, ['kind', 'requestId', 'runId', 'expectedTaskVersion', 'dispositionRequestId', 'sourceUpdateId', 'acknowledgeUnknown', 'instruction']);
    const unknown = row.kind === 'unknown-verification';
    if (!['unknown-verification', 'result-verification', 'error-recovery'].includes(String(row.kind)) || Object.keys(row).length !== (unknown ? 8 : 6) || ![row.requestId, row.runId, row.sourceUpdateId].every(uuid) || row.requestId === row.runId || !positive(row.expectedTaskVersion) || !instruction(row.instruction) || unknown && (!uuid(row.dispositionRequestId) || row.requestId === row.dispositionRequestId || row.acknowledgeUnknown !== true) || !unknown && (row.dispositionRequestId !== undefined || row.acknowledgeUnknown !== undefined))
        throw denied();
    return row;
}
export function readTaskRunSourceFollowupCandidate(value) {
    const row = taskInput(value, ['schema', 'kind', 'taskId', 'expectedTaskVersion', 'runId', 'sessionId', 'disposition', 'sourceUpdateId', 'sourceTaskVersion', 'sourceEventId', 'reference', 'originalNativeRequestId', 'originalInputSha256', 'originalEvidenceSha256']), unknown = row.kind === 'unknown-verification';
    const disposition = unknown ? readTaskRunSubmissionDisposition(row.disposition) : undefined, reference = businessObjectReference(row.reference);
    if (Object.keys(row).length !== (unknown ? 14 : 13) || row.schema !== 'teloa.task-run-source-followup-candidate/v1' || !['unknown-verification', 'result-verification', 'error-recovery'].includes(String(row.kind)) || ![row.taskId, row.runId, row.sourceUpdateId, row.sourceEventId, row.originalNativeRequestId].every(uuid) || !sha(row.originalInputSha256) || typeof row.sessionId !== 'string' || !/^[-a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,128}$/.test(row.sessionId) || !positive(row.expectedTaskVersion) || !positive(row.sourceTaskVersion) || Number(row.sourceTaskVersion) >= Number(row.expectedTaskVersion) || unknown && (row.runId !== disposition.runId || row.sessionId !== disposition.sessionId || row.originalNativeRequestId !== disposition.nativeRequestId || row.originalInputSha256 !== disposition.inputSha256 || row.originalEvidenceSha256 !== null) || !unknown && (row.disposition !== undefined || !sha(row.originalEvidenceSha256)))
        throw denied();
    return { ...row, ...(disposition ? { disposition } : {}), reference };
}
export function readTaskRunSourceFollowup(value) {
    const row = taskInput(value, ['schema', 'kind', 'requestId', 'taskId', 'taskVersion', 'sessionId', 'originalRunId', 'disposition', 'sourceUpdateId', 'sourceTaskVersion', 'sourceEventId', 'reference', 'instruction', 'confirmedAt', 'notice', 'originalNativeRequestId', 'originalInputSha256', 'originalEvidenceSha256']), unknown = row.kind === 'unknown-verification';
    if (Object.keys(row).length !== (unknown ? 18 : 17) || row.schema !== 'teloa.task-run-source-followup/v1' || !uuid(row.requestId) || row.notice !== (unknown ? sourceFollowupNotice : row.kind === 'error-recovery' ? errorRecoveryNotice : resultFollowupNotice) || !instruction(row.instruction) || typeof row.confirmedAt !== 'string' || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(row.confirmedAt)) || new Date(row.confirmedAt).toISOString() !== row.confirmedAt)
        throw denied();
    const candidate = readTaskRunSourceFollowupCandidate({ schema: 'teloa.task-run-source-followup-candidate/v1', kind: row.kind, taskId: row.taskId, expectedTaskVersion: row.taskVersion, runId: row.originalRunId, sessionId: row.sessionId, ...(row.disposition === undefined ? {} : { disposition: row.disposition }), sourceUpdateId: row.sourceUpdateId, sourceTaskVersion: row.sourceTaskVersion, sourceEventId: row.sourceEventId, reference: row.reference, originalNativeRequestId: row.originalNativeRequestId, originalInputSha256: row.originalInputSha256, originalEvidenceSha256: row.originalEvidenceSha256 });
    if (row.requestId === row.originalRunId || row.requestId === candidate.disposition?.requestId || row.requestId === candidate.originalNativeRequestId)
        throw denied();
    return { ...row, ...(candidate.disposition ? { disposition: candidate.disposition } : {}), reference: candidate.reference };
}
